text:
Liam: Heads up — ACME flagged a ~2.3k discrepancy on their March invoice, says embedding units look doubled vs what they expect.
Sophie: on it. Do we have an immediate hypothesis?
Liam: Our early signal is a backfill job that ran Mar 12 — looks like it counted both pre-quant and post-quant tokens for embeddings when the rate-limiter switched buckets.
Ravi: can you paste the log lines?
Liam: sure, from ingestion-worker-3:```
[2026-03-12T03:07:21Z] INFO processed_batch id=xyz embeds=512 tokens=10240 customer=acme tier=hosted
[2026-03-12T03:07:21Z] DEBUG rate_bucket=dedicated -> billed_bucket=hosted (fallback)
[2026-03-12T03:07:21Z] INFO written_usage customer=acme tokens=10240 embeds=512 billed=true
```
Maya: looks like when the fallback happened we didn't mark the dedup flag on the backfill path. That could double-count if the backfill retried.
billing-bot: Invoice generation job 2026-03-15 started for customer=acme invoice_id=inv_2026_03_ACME
Ravi: if it's a double-count, we can recompute usage by de-duping on (customer, request_id) and rerun the aggregator for Mar 12-13.
Sophie: what's the estimated customer impact in dollars?
Liam: preliminary calc: ~460k extra tokens billed -> ~$2,300 at our hosted token rate.
Maya: we should prepare a proactive credit and a note explaining root cause + fix.
Ravi: I'll draft the SQL to identify duplicates:```
SELECT request_id, customer_id, COUNT(*) as cnt, SUM(tokens) as tokens_sum
FROM usage_events
WHERE customer_id = 'acme' AND event_time BETWEEN '2026-03-12' AND '2026-03-13'
GROUP BY request_id, customer_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
Ravi: then run recompute_aggregates(start='2026-03-12', end='2026-03-13', customer='acme', dedup=true) in staging first.
Sophie: get me results from staging before we touch production invoices. Also tag CS so they can preempt the customer.
Liam: pinged #customer-success with brief note and link to this thread.
Maya: quick note on prevention: we'll add a dedup flag at write path and a check in the billing pipeline to ignore events with duplicate request_ids within 24h.
billing-bot: Backfill job queued job_id=bf_7729 (owner=Ravi)
Ravi: running in staging now, ETA ~15m.
Liam: I ran an adhoc script to estimate duplicates: found 1,210 duplicate request_ids for acme in that window.
Maya: that matches the overshoot estimate.
Sophie: approve provisional credit of $2,300 to be applied to next invoice, pending final recompute? Approve/deny please.
Ravi: approve.
Maya: approve.
Liam: approve, + note to CS to offer one-time waiver if they prefer a refund.
Sophie: ok all approved. Ravi, once staging is green, run prod recompute and file an adjustment.
Ravi: staging finished OK. Diff: 460,320 tokens removed, 512 embed units removed, billed_delta = -$2,300.22.
billing-bot: Adjustment created adj_1759_acme amount=-2300.22 status=pending_approval
Sophie: tagging finance-ops for signoff. @Maya can you add the accounting memo (GL codes + adj reason)?
Maya: added memo: GL 4102 (Usage Revenue) correction, reason: duplicate events from backfill fallback; supporting csv uploaded to /gsheets/acme_billing/adj_1759.csv
Liam: cs update sent to ACME: "We identified an internal metering issue that double-counted a subset of embedding events on Mar 12. We've issued a $2,300 credit to your next invoice and are implementing a fix."
Ravi: deployed preventive fix: dedup flag + 24h request_id filter to ingestion. Release: rwd-infra@2026.03.13
Maya: monitoring alert rule added: if billed_tokens_delta_per_hour > expected*1.5 for any customer, fire pager to finance oncall.
Sophie: good. Final ask: please attach the staging logs + diff CSV to the adjustment ticket and set status=approved after finance reviews.
Ravi: will do. attaching: /logs/staging/bf_7729/output.diff.csv and /logs/prod/recompute/adj_1759.diff.csv once prod run completes.
billing-bot: prod recompute completed at 2026-03-15T09:18:44Z, adj_1759 status=approved by finance_lead
Sophie: closing loop. Thanks everyone.
Liam: leaving a short retro note: add automated check in backfill worker to assert idempotency before writing usage rows.
Maya: I'll own that task — created ticket FIN-3287.
Sophie: thanks — marking this resolved. :white_check_mark:
